featured.name: TruckersMP's Halloween Convoy
featured.description:
### Our Halloween Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**!  

  The event takes place on the **31st October 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  

---

   ### **Information** 
   
   We will take to the roads of ETS2 in the dead of night during the witching hour. 
   Are you brave enough to enter? Who knows what might be lurking in the shadows!  
   
   You can find all the details via our [Blog Post](link)  
   
   ### :parking: | **Parking** 
   
   > You may park at any company available in **Paris** with a **no collision zone**. 
   
   ![Convoy Route](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/40c74b71-7a64-47ba-9bc4-a65bdfab5293.avif)
featured.rule:

* Double trailer configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)

* Buses are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.

* Participants with consistent lag must remain at the back of the convoy.

All other TruckersMP rules apply.

featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - November 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official November Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Tirana, traveling through the Balkan to end in Rijeka.

The event takes place on the **8th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P3QHIrvSHSpH2)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38307.1791459212.jpg)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Tirana** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121262-official-ets2-convoy-november-2026/)**!

featured.name: Official ATS Convoy - Boat show
featured.description:
### You're **all invited** to haul a boat to Yakima! 👀  

> The yearly Yakima Sprint Boat racing now has a new edition with a regular boat show that is being held at the end of November. For this we require several boats to being hauled to various companies in Yakima from their storage location in Wenatchee.

The event takes place on the **14th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  

---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your timezone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P4sECCF_QEadR)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38596.1792995339.jpg)

---

### :truck: | **Cargo**  

We kindly request you to haul a boat  

You can use our TruckersMP Truck Delivery Dispatcher to select your cargo to Yakima.

![Truck Delivery Dispatcher](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/516fd848-53ae-41ba-9b78-7974591827c0.avif)  

If you want to know more about our Truck Delivery Dispatcher you can read this [article](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/1410)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Wenatchee** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you into Coastline Mining.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121346-official-ats-convoy-boat-show/)**!

upcoming.rule:
🚛 RÈGLEMENT DU CONVOI – COMMU MICKE
🎯 1. Esprit du convoi
Le convoi doit rester convivial, respectueux et organisé.
Tout le monde est le bienvenu, débutant comme joueur expérimenté.
Le but est de rouler ensemble et passer un bon moment.
Aucun règlement de compte ou provocation pendant le convoi.
🎙️ 2. Communication
Le vocal est obligatoire pendant le convoi.
Le micro doit rester disponible pour les consignes importantes.
Éviter de parler pendant les annonces des organisateurs.
Les encadrants et responsables du convoi sont prioritaires pour les communications.
🚦 3. Respect du convoi
Respecter l'ordre de départ donné par les organisateurs.
Garder une distance de sécurité avec le camion devant.
Ne pas doubler dans le convoi, sauf autorisation d'un encadrant.
Ne pas dépasser le véhicule ouvreur.
Éviter les freinages brusques et changements de voie inutiles.
🛣️ 4. Code de la route
Respecter les limitations de vitesse et les règles de circulation.
Respecter les feux, stops et priorités.
Utiliser les clignotants.
Ne pas provoquer volontairement d'accident.
Ne pas conduire de manière dangereuse ou agressive.
🚛 5. Dépassements
Les dépassements sont interdits dans le convoi, sauf consigne contraire.
Si un camion est en difficulté, prévenir les encadrants.
Ne pas profiter d'un dépassement pour accélérer et créer un écart avec le groupe.
🅿️ 6. Arrêts et pauses
Ne pas s'arrêter au milieu de la route sans raison.
En cas de problème, accident ou déconnexion, prévenir les encadrants.
Lors des pauses, attendre les consignes avant de repartir.
🚨 7. Accident / problème

En cas d'accident :

Garder son calme.
Se mettre en sécurité si possible.
Prévenir un encadrant.
Attendre les instructions.
Ne pas bloquer volontairement la circulation.
📸 8. Photos et vidéos
Les photos et vidéos sont autorisées et encouragées.
Éviter de s'arrêter ou de modifier le convoi uniquement pour prendre une photo.
Des photos de groupe pourront être réalisées à l'arrivée.
❌ 9. Comportements interdits
🚫 Percutages volontaires.
🚫 Freinages volontaires sur les autres joueurs.
🚫 Trolls et provocations.
🚫 Insultes et manque de respect.
🚫 Blocage volontaire de la route.
🚫 Dépassements dangereux.
🚫 Conduite dangereuse volontaire.
👮 10. Encadrement
Les encadrants assurent le bon déroulement du convoi.
Leurs consignes doivent être respectées pendant le trajet.
En cas de problème, privilégier le dialogue.
🏁 11. Arrivée
Se garer selon les indications des encadrants.
Une photo de groupe pourra être organisée.
Après les dernières consignes, chacun est libre de quitter le convoi.
❤️ RÈGLE N°1

ON VIENT POUR ROULER ENSEMBLE, PAS POUR BATTRE UN RECORD.

Respect • Sécurité • Bonne humeur • Esprit communautaire 🚛❤️

🟠 COMMU MICKE – ETS2

![](https://s1.imgbb.ws/file/storage-sv1/in3cf.jpg)
## 万圣节狩猎

今年，一些可恶的Haulie逃到了德国地区，并将它们藏在没人能找到的地方。现在，我们需要您来帮助我们，以免为时已晚！

我们需要您的帮助，在 10 月 31 日 20:30 和 23:00 期间前来，并尝试找到所有的Haulie！

你会接受挑战并在逃脱之前寻找丢失的Haulie吗？加入狩猎，让我们把Haulie带回它们所属的地方。

根据一些线索，我们已经知道了Haulie所在的大致区域，它们都还在那里！有**8个**Haulie可供发现：紫色、绿色、蓝色、黄色、橙色和红色Haulie，以及**2个**滚动的Haulie。

活动将于 10 月 31 日 20:30 开始，您必须在23:00找到所有Haulie！

**无需任何DLC！**



-----



## 怎么玩？

**8个**Haulie被困在我们给出的区域中，如果您是最快找到所有Haulie的人，您将获得由**Super CC**提供的特别奖品！

所有Haulie都将由我们的活动团队员工代表，他们的前缀与他们所托运的Haulie相匹配，如：“SE|Rolling Haulie” （此前缀中文翻译："SE|滚动的Haulie“）

***请注意，在参与本次活动时，不要使用任何TPC工具，这可能会导致您的成绩作废！***

-----



## 活动是如何进行的？

在服务器开启时，选择我们的活动服务器，服务器将不会启用碰撞，这也意味着，所有道路规则将不适用。

![](https://s2.imgbb.ws/file/storage-sv2/iBO3T.jpg)
### *您必须从 **慕尼黑** 出发*

当您找到了一个Haulie时，请打开您的TAB，用F12截图 **并展示出自己的卡车**，以证明您找到了它，如果不符合要求将视为无效的提交！



-----



## 奖品！

## - 第一名的个人：75元红包
## - 第二名的个人：50元红包
## - 第三名的个人：25元红包



-----

## Notes: If you are an international player whose native language is not Chinese, then you will not be able to compete for rankings because the form we provide does not have the Chinese communication software and cannot be submitted.

-----



## 提交处：

upcoming.name: NorthStar Group | Novi Farewell Convoy
upcoming.description:
-----

### This Event marks the final chapter of Novi Trucking, now continuing its journey alongside NorthStar Group, as we celebrate the miles we’ve shared together
###

-----

**Welcome to NorthStar Group | Novi Farewell Convoy**

Hosted by NorthStar Group, we invite the TruckersMP community to join us for one final drive as we close the chapter of Novi Trucking and begin a new journey together. This Convoy is more than just an event; it is a tribute to everything Novi Trucking has been - the friendships formed, the memories created, and the roads we’ve travelled as a community

While this marks the end of one name, it is not the end of the journey. With Novi Trucking now merged into NorthStar Group, the road continues forward, carrying with it the legacy and spirit built over time

Join us as we take our final miles together under the Novi Trucking name - celebrating the past, honouring the journey, and looking ahead to what comes next. Below you’ll find all the key information to ensure a smooth, respectful, and memorable Convoy

![](https://i.postimg.cc/HWRf9DFz/Novi-NSG.png)

-----

# 📅 Event Information
* Date: Sun, 1st Nov, 2026
* Server: TBD
* Meet-up Time: 16:00 UTC
* Departure Time: 17:00 UTC

* Starting City: Duisburg (Slots)
* Destination: Bern (Charmey)
* Distance: 948km
* DLC Required: None

![](https://i.postimg.cc/wxQmhg1D/Novi-NSG(2).png)
